answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the thread queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. The fable index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 374 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ripple. The fee repeats 29 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
